card.name: Linking words in NSAID cardiovascular warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (cause, commas, 'and', 'of') inside NSAID cardiovascular risk warnings, right before terms like stroke or shortness of breath. Also fires on a few similar spots in tadalafil label text.

modes.label: NSAID boxed warning
modes.description: Verb, comma or 'and' within the sentence about serious cardiovascular thrombotic events such as myocardial infarction and stroke.
modes.example: including myocardial infarction<< and>> stroke, which can be fatal.

modes.description: Comma in a list of cardiovascular symptoms patients should watch for.

modes.description: Linking word or space in tadalafil contraindication and warning lists.
modes.example: • History<< of>> known serious hypersensitivity reaction to tadalafil
